resolving a concrete blocker to a first runnable experiment. Instantiate the

part of constructing the candidate and remains allowed.

It does not directly construct or execute a candidate, nor does it resolve a specific execution blocker. The history shows the agent has already inspected relevant code and should now construct a candidate.
